item.title: Marugame Castle: Towering Stone Walls — Guide
item.description: Marugame Castle is one of Japan’s twelve castles to retain its original wooden keep, and though the keep itself is one of the smallest, the castle is famous for something else: its stone walls. Rising in tiers up the hill of Kameyama, the ramparts are among the tallest and most beautifully curved in Japan, sweeping upward in graceful concave lines to a total height of around 60 metres — a masterpiece of Edo-period stone-fitting.
